title: The Pensioner's House room description reverts after the quest it describes completes. It updates to 'the staff bears its cloth again' as soon as the banner is *found* (before it's given to Ossett), but after I actually hand the banner over and Ossett's own line says 'He hangs it on the bare staff himself,' the room description reverts to the original 'A tidy house; a bare banner-staff over the mantel.'
where: The Pensioner's House, after 'The Pensioner's Errand' completes
